recording.note: One fresh two-rope four-pulley Modelica experiment. The diagram supplies only A acceleration, all other numeric sizes/masses illustrative.

experiments.title: Four pulleys and two ropes · find B acceleration
experiments.description: Given block A accelerates left at 6 m/s². One rope passes around horizontal moving P1; a separate rope connects P1's axle over fixed P2, under moving P3, over fixed P4, and attaches to block B (P3 is also attached to B). Stock MSL ideal transmissions compute P1 and B motion, giving B 1 m/s² upward. All masses, radii and positions are illustrative; the diagram does not provide them.
